label: MacBook Air 13-inch (M3)
description: 13.6-inch fanless ultraportable with Apple M3 (2024), Wi-Fi 6E, two Thunderbolt/USB 4 ports.
notes: No RJ45 and no onboard Ethernet controller; wired requires a Thunderbolt/USB-C dongle (1GbE typical). Wi-Fi 6E is the default path, so a lab link to this node is wireless unless a dongle is modelled.
